"""D459 independent final delivery verification and exact-owned scope closure."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment_retry14_baseline')
RAW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/main_comparison/d459_d458_diagnosis'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import ieee_tc_preflight as p
load=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text())
def save(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
identity=p.scope_identity(p.cg_path().name)
save(RAW/'finalize_identity.json',identity)
expected=load(RAW/'curation_identity.json')
owner=p.scope_identity(expected['unit'])
assert owner==expected and p.scope_still_owned(owner)
group=Path(owner['path'])
members={str(f):f.read_text().split() for f in group.rglob('cgroup.procs')}
assert members and all(not v for v in members.values())
resources={k:(group/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.peak','memory.events','memory.swap.current')}
assert p.scope_still_owned(owner)
subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','stop',owner['unit']],check=True)
save(OUT/'curation_closure.json',dict(identity=owner,actual_recursive_procs_empty=True,
    recursive_cgroup_procs=members,resources=resources))
for row in load(OUT/'executed_sources.json')['sources']:
    assert p.digest(Path(row['path']))==row['sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(row['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
check=load(OUT/'delivery_check.json')
for name,expected in check['current_ref_checks'].items():assert p.digest(Path(name))==expected
for name,raw in [('stages.json',RAW/'stages/summary.json'),('control.json',RAW/'control.json'),
                 ('planning.json',RAW/'planning.json')]:
    assert load(OUT/name)==load(raw)
receipt=Path(check['compression_receipt']['path'])
assert p.digest(receipt)==check['compression_receipt']['sha256']
entries=load(receipt)['entries']
assert len(entries)==10
for row in entries:
    assert not Path(row['source']).exists()
    assert p.digest(Path(row['archive']))==row['archive_sha256']
    assert row['source_sha256']==row['first_roundtrip_sha256']==row['second_roundtrip_sha256']==row['audit_sha256']
    local=load(Path(row['source']).parents[2]/'compression_receipt.json')
    assert all(local[key]==value for key,value in row.items())

 str(ROOT/'docs/ieee_tc/METRIC_PROTOCOL_SINGLE_RUN_V2.md'):'193bf1535af1aa50f83d98dc2e944ecbdc7bd27aa96baeca82f0654e02f9357d',
 str(ROOT/'configs/generated/lora_manifest_1000.json'):'3b69bd0a6888aa56e98c3b9efb61234860d4b80f25729cfea6b79126d19127df',
 '/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines/scripts/replay_openai_trace.py':'04f3eb52c64c6d684dec3ecef1e6a450d687e0922430c2d77932917e4a38fc22',
 '/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines/scripts/run_serverlessllm_relayserve_continuation.sh':'337dceec7a528b7816e5a55e81d3c26f3feb1499976a4d049faa69809acec499'}
for name,expected in identities.items():assert p.digest(Path(name))==expected,name
seal=p.verify_seal(Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/slora_qualification/d435_20261011/protected_before.json'))
assert seal['pass'] and seal['entry_count']==147
assert not subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
save(OUT/'final_verification.json',dict(passed=True,scope=identity,protected=seal,
    preserved_identities=identities,source_refs_verified=len(check['current_ref_checks']),
    compressed_archive_and_receipt_matches=10,
    verifier_source=dict(path=str(Path(__file__)),sha256=p.digest(Path(__file__)),content=Path(__file__).read_text())))
